title: Russell Street Bungalow
description:
In the heart of historic Lockeland Springs, from the Russell Street Bungalow you can walk to the bars at Five Points, independent restaurants, boutique shopping, comfy cafes, and the beautiful Shelby Bottoms Greenway. It's quick and easy to get anywhere in town from this home base, and you don't have to get on the highway in order to explore the city. You'll come and go with a key code and enjoy the privacy of your own suite. We look forward to your stay.
